scope.reason: Recompute canonical paragraph text and inline projections from captured source material, preserving numeric superscript indices with caret delimiters. Re-read printed title order and opening, operative and signature roles from stored source; preserve inline bold and italic emphasis in PDFs. Read publisher page furniture and preserve document numbers and footnote targets from stored PDF text; preserve sentence continuations across spacing and indentation while retaining explicit paragraph points. Translate separately extracted reference positions after inline indices are stripped. These values have no separate feature storage.
